full_prompt_en: A square monochrome architectural drawing shows a large domed stone building from a low three-quarter viewpoint, surrounded by open white paper. The main tower rises at the left center, with a ribbed rounded dome and a narrow lantern capped by a fine spire. Below it, stacked arcades, columns, cornices, and deep arched openings give the facade substantial relief. A second smaller dome and elaborate front volume extend to the right, their edges becoming lighter and less complete toward the far side. At ground level, two dark archways occupy the left and center, with shaded interiors that contrast sharply with the pale stone faces. A wide staircase climbs from the lower right toward a raised central landing, its steps receding in closely spaced lines. The base of the drawing dissolves into faint ground marks, while the upper and side edges leave broad blank areas around the architecture. Fine graphite or ink-like strokes define window frames, masonry seams, balustrades, and carved molding. Areas of dense crosshatching shade the undersides of arches and the junctions between projecting parts; exposed wall planes are mostly white with light tonal wash. The building is drawn with careful perspective but retains the exploratory energy of visible construction marks and unfinished edges. No people, signage, or readable text appear in the scene. Diffuse implied daylight arrives from the upper left, brightening the front-facing stone and leaving the deep entries dark without a hard ground shadow. The overall composition balances a highly worked central mass with generous blank paper, allowing the rhythm of domes, arches, and ascending stairs to carry the view.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形单色建筑绘图从较低的三分之四视角呈现一座带穹顶的大型石建筑，四周留有空阔白纸。主塔在左侧中央升起，有带肋线的圆穹顶和一座细尖顶的窄塔亭。其下，层叠拱廊、立柱、檐口与深凹拱形开口让立面具有厚实的起伏。第二座较小的穹顶和复杂的正面体块向右延伸，其边缘越远越淡，也越不完整。地面层的左侧和中央有两处深色拱口，阴影中的内部与浅色石面形成鲜明对比。宽阶梯从右下爬向抬高的中央平台，台阶以紧密线条向远处退去。画面基部消散为浅淡地面笔迹，而上方及两侧边缘为建筑留下大块空白。细密的石墨或墨水般笔划界定窗框、砌缝、栏杆与雕花线脚。密集交叉排线为拱底和突出部分的交接处着阴影；外露墙面大多保持白色，仅有淡淡调子。建筑透视细致，却保留可见构造线与未完成边缘带来的探索活力。画面没有人物、标牌或可读文字。暗示性的散射日光从左上到来，使正面石材明亮、深凹入口阴暗，却没有硬朗的地面投影。整体构图以精细经营的中央体量平衡宽阔纸面留白，让穹顶、拱券与上升台阶的节奏承载视线。
style_prompt_en: The image has a monochrome ink-sketch surface with precise perspective and an openly worked hand. Thin contour lines describe large geometry, while fine crosshatching and short tonal strokes darken recesses and articulate relief. Pale paper remains visible across broad regions; gray wash and near-black marks concentrate within the central mass. Edges vary from sharply finished to faint or incomplete, letting the subject seem to emerge gradually from the blank field. Repeated curved openings, stepped levels, and projecting moldings provide a layered rhythm without color. Implied diffuse light leaves exposed planes almost white and places the deepest values under overhangs. A low oblique viewpoint gives the forms height and depth, while generous margin space keeps the intricate detail breathable. The overall effect is scholarly, atmospheric, and tactile, poised between exact construction and exploratory drawing.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有单色墨线速写表面，透视精确而手工经营的痕迹坦然显露。细轮廓线描述大几何形，细交叉排线和短调子笔划加深凹处并刻出浮起层次。浅色纸面在宽阔区域保持可见；灰色淡洗与近黑笔迹聚集在中央体量内。边缘从锐利完成到浅淡未尽不断变化，使主体仿佛从空白中逐渐浮现。重复的弧形开口、层阶和外凸线脚无需颜色也能提供层叠节奏。暗示性的散射光让外露平面几乎全白，最深明度落在悬挑下方。较低的斜向视点赋予形体高度与纵深，宽阔留白则让精密细节仍能呼吸。整体效果严谨、富大气感且可触，处于准确构建与探索性绘图之间。
theme_en: A grand domed stone building and staircase rendered as a monochrome architectural sketch
theme_zh: 以单色建筑速写呈现的宏伟穹顶石建筑与阶梯
name: Renaissance architecture
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
